title: What a Night! Tapas, Laughs, and Hidden Gems in Granada
text:
We all knew tapas came free in Granada (amazing, right?), but what we didn't know was the history behind it—and all the cool little stories and secrets hidden in the city’s streets. This tour gave us that and took it to the next level!

We hit up four absolutely gorgeous bars—seriously, total hidden gems we’d never have found on our own. Each place had its own vibe, and the tapas? Next level. Super tasty and really high quality.

Now, I usually just go for a beer or a glass of wine, but our guide (who was super friendly and really knew her stuff) made drink suggestions that blew our minds—verm
author: W2516ZPlisab
